name: Wall push-up
instructions: Stand arm's length from a wall, hands at chest height, and press away. The gentlest push-up start.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Hands on a table or bed, body in a straight line, lower your chest and press back up.

name: Knee push-up
instructions: Push-up from the knees, keeping a straight line from head to knees.

name: Standard push-up
instructions: Hands under shoulders, body rigid, chest to the floor and press up.

name: Wide push-up
instructions: Push-up with the hands wider than the shoulders to bias the chest.

name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Hands together under the chest forming a diamond; elbows stay close.

name: Decline push-up
instructions: Feet on a chair, hands on the floor; a harder push-up for the upper chest.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the crown of the head toward the floor and press up.

name: Chair dips
instructions: Hands on the edge of a chair, legs out front, bend the elbows and press back up.

name: Bench dips
instructions: Dips with the feet further out and the chest close to the chair.

name: Band chest press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and press both handles forward until the arms lock.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on your back with dumbbells at the chest and press straight up.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: From a seated or standing position press the dumbbells overhead.

name: Band row
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and pull the handles to your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Towel row
instructions: Loop a towel around a door handle and pull yourself toward it, leaning back.

name: Superman
instructions: Lying face down, lift the arms and legs off the floor and hold briefly.

name: Table inverted row
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge, and pull your chest up to it.

name: Band lat pulldown
instructions: Anchor the band high and pull the handles down to your shoulders.

name: Band face pull
instructions: Pull the band toward your face with the elbows high, opening the chest.

name: Dumbbell row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with one hand on a chair and row the dumbbell to your ribs.

name: Band bicep curl
instructions: Stand on the band and curl the handles to your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell bicep curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells with the elbows pinned to your sides.

name: Prone Y-T-W raise
instructions: Face down, lift the arms into a Y, then a T, then a W, pausing at each.

name: Reverse snow angel
instructions: Face down, sweep the arms from the hips overhead without touching the floor.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width, sit the hips back and down, then drive up through the heels.

name: Sumo squat
instructions: Wide stance with toes out; squat between the feet.

name: Chair squat
instructions: Sit back to lightly touch a chair and stand back up under control.

name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Step one foot back, drop the knee toward the floor, and return.

name: Forward lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, both knees to 90 degrees, then push back.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Lunge forward and continue walking across the room, alternating legs.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Back foot on a chair, lower straight down on the front leg and press up.

name: Jump squat
instructions: Squat down and explode upward, landing softly.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Back against a wall, thighs parallel to the floor; hold.

name: Calf raise
instructions: Rise onto the toes and lower slowly.

name: Single-leg calf raise
instructions: Balance on one leg and rise onto the toes.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lying on your back, press the hips up and squeeze the glutes.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
instructions: Glute bridge with one foot lifted; keep the hips level.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Shoulders on a chair, feet on the floor, drive the hips up.

name: Step-up
instructions: Step onto a sturdy chair or step and back down, alternating legs.

name: Lateral lunge
instructions: Step wide to one side, sit into that hip, and push back to centre.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at the chest and squat between the feet.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips, sliding the dumbbells down the thighs, then stand tall.

name: Donkey kick
instructions: On all fours, kick one heel up toward the ceiling keeping the knee bent.

name: Fire hydrant
instructions: On all fours, lift one knee out to the side and lower.

name: Bodyweight good morning
instructions: Hands behind the head, hinge at the hips with a flat back, then rise.

name: Plank
instructions: Elbows under the shoulders, body in a straight line; hold and breathe.

name: Side plank
instructions: On one forearm, lift the hips so the body is straight; swap sides.

name: Crunches
instructions: Curl the shoulders off the floor using the abs, not the neck.

name: Reverse crunch
instructions: Lift the hips off the floor, curling the knees toward the chest.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Alternate elbow to opposite knee in a pedalling motion.

name: Leg raises
instructions: Lying flat, lift straight legs to vertical and lower slowly.

name: Flutter kicks
instructions: Small, fast alternating leg kicks a little above the floor.

name: Mountain climbers
instructions: From a plank, drive the knees toward the chest one at a time.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Seated, lean back and rotate the torso side to side.

name: Dead bug
instructions: On your back, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the back flat.

name: Hollow hold
instructions: Lying flat, lift the shoulders and legs and hold with the lower back pressed down.

name: Bird dog
instructions: On all fours, extend the opposite arm and leg and hold briefly; alternate.

name: V-ups
instructions: Lift the arms and legs together to meet above the chest.

name: Toe touches
instructions: Legs up, reach the hands toward the toes and lower.

name: Plank shoulder taps
instructions: In a high plank, tap the opposite shoulder without rocking the hips.

name: Marching in place
instructions: Lift the knees alternately at a brisk walking pace.

name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Jump the feet wide while raising the arms overhead, then back in.

name: High knees
instructions: Run in place driving the knees up to hip height.

name: Butt kicks
instructions: Jog in place kicking the heels up toward the glutes.

name: Skater hops
instructions: Leap side to side onto one leg, swinging the other behind.

name: Burpees
instructions: Squat, kick back to a plank, push up, jump the feet in and leap up.

name: Squat thrust
instructions: A burpee without the jump — easier on the knees.

name: Star jumps
instructions: From a crouch, jump up spreading the arms and legs into a star.

name: Shadow boxing
instructions: Stay light on the feet and throw quick straight punches.

name: Skipping (imaginary rope)
instructions: Skip in place with small bounces and quick wrists.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: On all fours, alternate arching and rounding the spine with the breath.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: From a deep lunge, rotate and reach the top arm to the ceiling; swap sides.

name: Arm circles
instructions: Sweep the arms in small then large circles, both directions.

name: Leg swings
instructions: Hold a support and swing each leg forward and back, then side to side.

name: Hip circles
instructions: Hands on hips, draw big circles with the pelvis both ways.

name: Neck rolls
instructions: Slowly roll the head in a half-circle from shoulder to shoulder.

name: Thoracic opener
instructions: Kneel with hands on a chair, sink the chest and reach forward.

name: Downward dog
instructions: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high, press the heels down.

name: Cobra stretch
instructions: Face down, press the palms down and lift the chest gently.

name: Child's pose
instructions: Kneel, sit back on the heels and stretch the arms forward on the floor.

name: Standing hamstring stretch
instructions: Rest one heel on a chair, keep the leg straight and hinge forward.

name: Quad stretch
instructions: Stand tall, pull one heel toward the glutes and hold; swap sides.

name: Band shoulder dislocates
instructions: Hold the band wide and pass it overhead and behind, then return.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Hinge to the floor, walk the hands out to a plank, then walk back and stand.

name: Walkout push-up
instructions: Inchworm out to a plank, add a push-up, then walk back.

name: Bear crawl
instructions: On hands and toes with the knees just off the floor, crawl forward and back.

name: Bear hold
instructions: Hold the bear-crawl position with the knees hovering; keep the back flat.

name: Dumbbell Turkish get-up
instructions: From lying to standing while holding one dumbbell overhead, then reverse.
